summary: Increased left basilar pleural-parenchymal opacity, likely worsening left pleural effusion with adjacent consolidation.

findings.rationale: The current image shows more homogeneous left basilar and retrocardiac opacity with greater blunting of the left base than prior, though projection differs slightly.
There is denser adjacent left retrocardiac airspace opacity, although some of the increased density may overlap with the effusion and lower lung volume.
